games.title: A Dance of Fire and Ice
games.description: Strict one-button rhythm game where two orbiting planets travel along winding musical paths. Stay focused and tap in time with the beat.
games.tip: Click inside the game once it opens to focus controls, then use Space or mouse clicks on the beat.
games.note: First Unity WebGL load can take a few seconds on lower-end devices. Use Play Here (Alt) if needed.

games.title: Basket Random
games.description: Wild ragdoll physics basketball across changing courts, balls, and players. Score five baskets first to take the match solo or against a friend.
games.tip: Click inside the game once it opens to focus keyboard controls. Player 1 uses W and Player 2 uses Up Arrow.
games.note: If the primary source is slow on your network, switch to Play Here (Alt) for the backup mirror.
